DO-1101-02 Interacts with many different internal and external personnel and organizations. Recommends acquisition strategies and approaches. Identifies and implements improved approaches to deliver capability. Advises and supports in the definition of requirements and budgets. Implements acquisition plans.

Accurately determines program goals and objectives. Assesses and manages acquisition program risks. Proactively identifies cost, schedule, technical and/or programmatic risks. Reports schedule risks early and develops get well plans to ensure budget execution and mission accomplishment needs are met.

Develops and implements effective risk mitigation plans. Leads source selection activities and coordinates technical evaluation efforts with project leads. Prepares a variety of documents to include requirement statements, cost estimates, market research reports, justification & approvals, acquisition plans and other related acquisition documents.

Meets due dates for procurement packages. Holds contractor accountable to meet requirements identified in their contract. Consistently applies sound principles, concepts and work processes to problems and concerns routinely keeping higher management levels informed. Adheres to security policies/directives/SOPs.
Experience requirements are described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Group Coverage Qualification Standard for Administrative and Management Positions.

Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

In addition to meeting the basic requirement above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualification requirements listed below: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience at the next lower grade DR-01 / GS-11, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience includes applying concepts, principles, procedures, regulations, laws, and/or instructions applicable to pre and post award of contracts, leading source selection activities that included the technical evaluation of contractor proposals, and/or implementing acquisition strategies.

NOTE: Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

COMPETENCIES: Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Problem Solving, Communication, Business Management, Teamwork and Leadership IDEAL CANDIDATE: In addition to the specialized experience statements above, the ideal candidate would have the following skills and experience: Ideal candidate is a proactive and seasoned acquisition professional who thrives in a high-stakes, mission-driven environment.

They are not just an acquisition program manager; they are a strategic thinker and a leader who understands that their work directly contributes to national security. This individual is adept at navigating the complexities of the DoD acquisition landscape and is driven by the challenge of delivering cutting-edge capabilities to the warfighter.

Program manager- Candidate has a deep and practical understanding of the entire acquisition lifecycle, from the initial spark of a requirement to the final delivery and sustainment. They can speak with authority on everything from Simplified Acquisition Procedures and IDIQs to the nuances of R&D funding.

They don't just know the regulations; they understand the strategy behind them Leadership- While the position is non-supervisory, our ideal candidate is a recognized leader. They have a proven ability to lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), uniting scientists, analysts, and contracting officers toward a common goal.

They build bridges, foster open communication, and are respected for their ability to listen and integrate diverse perspectives.

Their colleagues see them as a reliable and indispensable partner Problem Solving- When faced with a roadblock-be it a funding shortfall, a technical challenge, or a schedule slip-this individual doesn't just report the problem; they come to the table with solutions.

They are skilled at risk analysis and mitigation, always looking ahead to anticipate challenges and develop contingency plans. They have the business acumen to evaluate contractor proposals with a critical eye and the confidence to hold them accountable Strategic Thinking- Candidate understands the gravity of JWAC's mission.

They are cleared for the nation's most sensitive information and carry that responsibility with the utmost integrity. They are resilient, adaptable, and comfortable with the unique pressures of working in a classified environment. PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work.

You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge and skills that can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

VA Careers - Pharmacy: https://youtube.com/embed/Fn_ickNBEws The Pharmacy Program Manager (Pharmacoeconomics/Formulary Management) is responsible for leading and coordinating pharmacoeconomic programs, formulary management activities, and cost-containment initiatives across VA North Texas.

Their scope spans Program Management, Administrative & Quality Assurance, Research & Education, Clinical Practice, and Communication. A. Program Management Leads cost-containment strategies, formulary maintenance, drug utilization reviews, and pharmacoeconomic research. Evaluates new medications for budget impact and formulary considerations.

Oversees cost-efficient use of high-cost or high-risk medications and may serve as approval authority. Conducts drug use evaluations, tracks KPIs, analyzes trends, and implements improvement plans. Manages Prior Authorization Drug Requests, therapeutic interchange activities, formulary reviews, and formulary change processes.

Develops medication criteria for use and tools to measure outcomes of formulary and pharmacoeconomic interventions. Collaborates on drug shortages, recalls, adverse drug event monitoring, and REMS activities. B. Administrative and Quality Assurance Performs data analytics using tools such as SQL, Power BI, Pyramid, and Excel.

Maintains pharmacoeconomic resources and references. Participates in quality improvement initiatives, policy development, and P&T Committee activities (facility and VISN). Ensures drug file accuracy and provides consultation on drug procurement, cost analysis, and patient care.

Documents cost-avoidance activities and supports performance measure achievement. C. Research and Education Supports trainee education and provides preceptorship in pharmacoeconomics and research. Coordinates clinical research, outcomes studies, and real-world evidence assessments.

Educates staff and providers on formulary management, guidelines, and cost-effective drug use. Contributes to VISN and national PBM research and drug utilization evaluation initiatives. Completes required training and supports staff development. D.

Clinical Reviews medication regimens for safety, effectiveness, dosing, interactions, and therapeutic outcomes. Monitors and reports drug errors, adverse reactions, allergies, and compliance. Applies laboratory interpretation skills for dose adjustments and patient assessment.

Monitors high-risk and high-cost medication use and formulary adherence using dashboards. Identifies misuse, inappropriate dosing, duplications, interactions, suboptimal response, and deprescribing opportunities. Provides cost-effective therapeutic recommendations and pharmacokinetic guidance.

Serves as a drug information resource and documents clinical interventions. E. Communication Maintains effective relationships with providers, nursing staff, and other departments. Serves as an authoritative resource to resolve medication-related questions and ensures positive communication experiences.

Basic Requirements for the 0193 Archeologist Series: A. Education 1.

Degree: Applicant must possess a degree in archeology or a closely related discipline that included 3 semester hours each in the following course areas: History of archeology. Archeology of a major geographical area such as North America or Africa.

Regional archeology, archeological cultures, or sites in a specific part or portion of a major geographical area to acquire or develop a foundation for regional specialization for professional development. Theory and methods of archeology.

Methods include, but are not limited to, typology, classification, sampling, cultural evolution, diffusion, dating, and analytical techniques.

Archeological field school, to provide a basic understanding of theoretical and practical approaches to research design implementation, field preservation techniques, and report preparation by participation in actual field work.

AND 6 semester hours of related course work in: geography, geology, or cultural geography; history, historiography, or historical archeology; environmental studies; scientific writing (nonfiction English composition); and/or surveying. AND Archeological Field School. Official transcripts must be provided to support these requirements. 2.

Related Curriculum: degree in anthropology (with emphasis on ethnology, physical anthropology, or scientific linguistics), history, American studies, or a related discipline may be accepted as satisfying in full the educational requirements, provided the curriculum supplied academic course work sufficiently similar to the requirements in A.1 (including archeological field school).

OR B. Combination of Education and Experience College-level education or training that provided knowledge equivalent to that described in A above, plus appropriate technical experience or additional education. OR C.

Experience Four years of archeological work experience that demonstrated a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional archeology. The work experience must have included archeology field experience, which may include that gained in an archeological field school.

Field experience should have included a combination of professional experience in archeological survey, excavation, laboratory analysis, and preparation of written materials.

Applicants with such field experience should, after additional experience under the direction of a higher grade archeologist, be able to demonstrate the ability to be a crew chief, directing the work of others at a single location as a part of a larger archeological project.

Basic Requirements for the 1301 Physical Scientist Series: Degree: physical science, engineering, or mathematics that included 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science such as mechanics, dynamics, properties of materials, and electronics.

OR Combination of education and experience -- education equivalent to one of the majors shown in A above that included at least 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

Develops and maintains relationships with partner organizations and other stakeholders that result in desired outcomes for natural and cultural resources.

Assists in developing and directing environmental and historic compliance procedures that ensure management actions are well informed and appropriately designed to protect and maintain natural and cultural resources and values.

Wir suchen eine:n Projekmanager:in für unser Projektmanagement Team an unserem Standort in Heidelberg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf!

s.h: Was dich in der Rolle als Projektmanager:in erwartet
s.t:
Du begleitest Arztpraxen vom ersten Tag an - von der technischen Einrichtung über die Schulung des Praxisteams bis zur aktiven Betreuung in den ersten Wochen nach dem Go-live. Dabei übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du managst deine Projekte eigenständig, bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Wechsel zu Nelly reibungslos klappt. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du bist nah an den Menschen, nah am Produkt und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit einem perfekten Start in die Zusammenarbeit mit Nelly durchstarten.
Du führst Implementierungsprojekte von A bis Z: von der technischen Integration über den Produktaufbau bis zur Schulung der Praxisteams (vor Ort & online) und der aktiven Nachbetreuung in der Hypercare-Phase (~30 Tage).
Du erkennst Risiken und Probleme im Projektverlauf frühzeitig, sprichst sie aktiv an und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein.
Du planst, koordinierst und priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf – auch wenn du mehrere Projekte parallel betreust.

Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der Kundenbetreuung – und echte Lust, noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
Proaktivität ist für dich selbstverständlich: du denkst mit, fragst nach und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
Starke Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift – ob du 5 oder 40 Personen schulst, du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf.
Strukturiertes Selbst- und Zeitmanagement: du organisierst dich eigenständig, auch wenn viele Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein – insbesondere im Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden-, Zahlungs- und Patientendaten.
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (regional, Baden-Württemberg); Führerschein Klasse B.
Teamorientiertes Arbeiten – deine Kolleg:innen können sich auf dich verlassen.
Nice to have: Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, Factoring oder Finance-Umfeld.

The Federal Program Manager serves as the Contractor's single point of contact for the Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and provides executive leadership, technical direction, and overall accountability for contract performance supporting the FEMA Office of the Chief Component Procurement Officer (OCCPO).

The PM is responsible for managing the successful execution of acquisition and procurement support services across the full acquisition lifecycle in support of steady-state and disaster-response requirements.

Oversee the development, review, and quality of acquisition documentation including Statements of Work (SOWs), Statements of Objectives (SOOs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), Performance Requirements Summaries (PRSs), Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), IGCEs, solicitation packages, contract modifications, and contract closeout documentation.

Direct acquisition coaching, awareness, and workforce training initiatives through instructor-led, virtual, and self-paced training while promoting acquisition best practices, lessons learned, and workforce development.
Lead acquisition data analytics and reporting activities by overseeing dashboard development, performance metrics, automation initiatives, data visualization, business intelligence reporting, trend analysis, and executive briefings that support informed acquisition decisions.
Manage onboarding, knowledge transfer, transition planning, and transition-out activities to ensure uninterrupted mission support and effective transfer of program knowledge to successor contractors or the Government.
Identify program risks, implement mitigation strategies, resolve technical and operational issues, and recommend continuous process improvements supporting acquisition excellence./
Manage program financial performance through forecasting, budgeting, expenditure tracking, variance analysis, resource planning, and corrective actions to ensure effective contract execution.

Demonstrated experience managing technical, financial, schedule, and operational performance for Federal acquisition support programs.
Extensive knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Homeland Security Acquisition Regulation (HSAR), Homeland Security Acquisition Manual (HSAM), FEMA Acquisition Manual (FAM), DHS Acquisition Life Cycle Framework (ALF), Acquisition Review Process (ARP), and Federal acquisition policies and procedures.

Experience leading modernization, technology transformation, and technical execution for large-scale student assessment platforms, including IT principles and concepts throughout the system development life cycle. 3.

Experience in systematically analyzing the collection, use, sharing, and maintenance of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and data protection throughout the data life cycle.

Knowledge in planning and executing technology projects for student assessments conducted at scale, such as major national or international data collections. 2. Skills in the technology and delivery of assessments of students' academic knowledge.

Partners closely with the IES CTO to shape the IT strategy for modern IT solutions that are scalable and focused on performance, resilience, and security. 3. Ability to serve as senior-level Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for multiple, IT contracts. 4.

Knowledge of inherently governmental functions related to federal information technology system requirements.

Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

s.h: About the role and what you will be doing
s.t:
The Senior Project Manager provides senior-level expertise to plan, organise, control, and deliver large, complex infrastructure and data centre migration projects across Ensono's client portfolio.

Operating within the Global Project and Implementation (GPI) practice, this role manages multiple company-wide initiatives simultaneously — from scope definition and budget planning through to delivery and post-implementation review.

A key part of this position involves building and maintaining strong relationships with client sponsors and internal leaders, including regular on-site engagement at the client's London office.

The Senior Project Manager interfaces directly with client executive management to understand critical business priorities and ensures every project is completed within agreed scope, quality, time, and cost constraints.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are clearly defined, understood, and documented

· Define project scope, risks, potential issues, and resource requirements at the outset of each engagement

· Ensure project benefits are realised while managing the impact of organisational change on the business and its clients

· Develop project phases and translate them into clear, measurable project plans

· Communicate internally and externally on delivery of work products, planning activities, and cross-organisational resource relationships

· Manage projects in full adherence to Ensono's project management methodology

· Manage project scope across mission, objectives, and requirements throughout the project lifecycle

· Manage project schedules, including key milestone dates and critical path tracking

· Lead the team in identifying project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; act as the primary escalation point and drive effective mitigation strategies to maintain project goals

· Provide leadership and strategic direction to the project team across all phases of delivery

· Oversee all project work streams, including timeline adherence, quality of deliverables, risk management, issue escalation, and stakeholder collaboration

· Work with all stakeholders to ensure governance frameworks and continuous improvement or transformation plans are established and maintained

· Establish deadlines, assign tasks, and monitor and summarise project progress for all relevant parties

· Develop business insights through analysis of results and communicate key findings to management to support data-driven decision-making

· Secure appropriate resources and personnel in collaboration with management to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget

· Escalate barriers, risks, and issues that may impact timelines or deliverables in a timely and appropriate manner

· Manage the development of polished executive-level presentations and deliver findings to internal associates and external clients clearly and concisely

· Manage project status reporting in line with prescribed timelines for each engagement

· Develop measurement processes and methods to assess progress towards project goals and outcomes

· Manage project costs and budgets throughout the full delivery lifecycle

· Facilitate cross-training to support job rotation and minimise gaps in assignment coverage

· Provide coaching and constructive feedback to all project team members

· Mentor less experienced associates within the project management practice

· Interface with client executive management on-site at the client's London office to understand and address critical business issues and concerns

· Proficient in MS Office and MS Project

· Strong financial management skills, including experience with project budgeting and cost control

· Effective team management skills with the ability to lead matrixed, cross-functional teams

· Strong leadership and strategic direction capabilities

· IT outsourcing knowledge

· Strong infrastructure management experience

· ITIL and/or ITSM knowledge

· Ability to organise and define work in complex or ambiguous situations

· Ability to travel to the client's office in London as required

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or equivalent experience

· Minimum of 7 years of complex IT programme and project management experience

· Demonstrated experience managing large-scale infrastructure and data centre migration projects

· MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering preferred

· Project financial and revenue recognition experience preferred

Ihr Ziel ist es, das gemeinsame agogische Verständnis und Handlungsfelder zu etablieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Dazu erarbeiten Sie Konzepte und Instrumente zur praktischen Umsetzung der agogischen Grundlagen unter Einbezug der gegebenen betriebswirtschaftlichen Aspekte und stellen sicher, dass die Klienten die passenden, teilhabeorientierten Leistungen erhalten. Zudem sind Sie verantwortlich für die Erhebung des individuellen Betreuungsbedarfs (IBB).

Neben der fachlichen Führung tragen Sie in der Geschäftsleitung sowie in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten operative und strategische Mitverantwortung.
Wir wenden uns an eine führungserfahrene Persönlichkeit mit höherer Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung in Sozial- oder Heilpädagogik (FH).

Ihr breites Fachwissen konnten Sie mit Erfahrungen in komplexen Wohn- und/oder arbeitsagogischen Bereichen sowie mit Erfahrung im Umgang mit erwachsenen Menschen mit Beeinträchtigung und Verhaltensauffälligkeiten ergänzen. Ausserdem zeichnet Sie Ihr sicherer Umgang mit Konzeptarbeit und der daraus resultierenden Umsetzung aus.

Sie pflegen einen pragmatischen Ansatz und überzeugen durch Ihre integrative Art, verbunden mit Klarheit und sozialer Kompetenz. Dabei fördern Sie die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit und einen offenen, wertschätzenden Umgang aller Beteiligten.Es erwartet Sie eine breit gefächerte Führungsaufgabe in einer in der Region gut verankerten Institution.

## Description de l'emploi ##
L'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) de la Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS), contribue à la réflexion et au pilotage de l'organisation des prestations sociales sur le territoire cantonal.

Elle analyse les besoins des différentes régions, coordonne les acteurs concernés et accompagne la mise en œuvre et l'évolution des dispositifs sociaux, en veillant à leur cohérence et à leur accessibilité pour la population.

Elle a également pour mission d'assurer une vision cohérente transverse pour le parc immobilier subventionné par la DGCS qui comprend notamment l'hébergement médico-social (EMS, EPSM, ESE) et les ateliers à vocation productive, soit environ 400 bâtiments gérés par 250 partenaires.
Afin de mener un projet ambitieux visant à établir une stratégie pour la mise aux normes énergétiques et d'adaptation aux conséquences du réchauffement climatique du parc immobilier de la structure socio-sanitaire, l'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) recherche **un·e Chef·fe de projet Plan climat.**
Pour de plus amples informations, veuillez consulter le cahier des charges en cliquant ici ou contacter Monsieur Mathieu Capcarrère, Conseiller stratégique, à l'adresse email: dgcs.recrutement@vd.ch

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Rügamer & Steiner ist die führende E-Mail Marketing Agentur hinter den erfolgreichsten E-Commerce Unternehmen in DE, AU & CH.
Über 150 Online Shops vertrauen uns bereits und erreichen mit uns die Herzen & Geldbeutel ihrer Kunden.
Da immer mehr Kunden ihr Vertrauen in Rügamer & Steiner setzen suchen wir Dich als Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d).
Du bist die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Kunden und Umsetzung.
Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.
Perfekt für dich, wenn du bereits Agenturerfahrung hast und weißt, wie wichtig Tempo, Struktur und saubere Prozesse sind.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben
Operative Umsetzung: Eigenständige Durchführung und technische Umsetzung von Marketing-Aufgaben und Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft.
Daily Management & Ticketing: Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung aller eingehenden Aufgaben und Kundenanfragen.
Schnelle Kundenkommunikation: Sicherstellung extrem kurzer Reaktionszeiten. Kunden erhalten zeitnah (z. B. innerhalb von 30 bis 60 Minuten) eine erste Rückmeldung oder Zwischenantwort bei Anfragen.
Koordination: Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (z. B. Grafik und Copy). Du erstellst Briefings, definierst klare Deadlines und nutzt Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. ClickUp) für reibungslose Abläufe.
Qualitätssicherung: Einleitung, Koordination und konsequente Nachverfolgung von Korrekturschleifen bis zur finalen Freigabe.
Problemlösung: Schnelles und pragmatisches Lösen von technischen oder organisatorischen Hürden im laufenden Betrieb.
Du trägst die Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige operative Umsetzung und die konsequente Einhaltung aller Deadlines. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass alle Prozesse technisch sauber, fehlerfrei und mit hoher Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit in der Kundenbetreuung umgesetzt werden.
Qualifikation

➜ Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement und Marketing
➜ Du arbeitest strukturiert, extrem organisiert und proaktiv
➜ Du bist zuverlässig und kannst viele parallele Aufgaben (Tickets) effizient managen
➜ Du denkst lösungsorientiert und bringst technisches Verständnis mit
➜ Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und schnell – sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen. Es gibt zudem ein monatliches Team-Lunch auf Kosten der Firma.
Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter: innen erhalten eine faire Vergütung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Daher benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte

The Revenue Strategy & Operations is the strategic engine and connective tissue for Zillow's Agent Sales organization. We deliver the highest-impact cross-functional programs in the business, align GTM, Revenue Strategy & Ops, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Media around a shared operating model, and architect the organizational designs that let the business scale new and existing product lines without fragmenting. About the role
The Principal Strategic GTM Program Manager leads high-impact, cross-functional programs that are critical to Zillow's strategic goals, shaping program strategy, governance, and execution across multiple teams. This role operates with broad autonomy to define outcomes, navigate ambiguity, and align senior leaders and partners to deliver complex, multi-year initiatives at scale. You will define the path forward in ambiguous situations without waiting for structure to be handed to you.
You Will Get To
Define and drive the overall strategy, scope, and success measures for complex, multi-workstream programs that span products, operations, and technology, ensuring clear alignment to Zillow's strategic priorities
Establish and lead program governance including cadence, decision forums, risk and issue management, and change control, enabling timely trade-offs and data-driven decisions with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
Orchestrate end-to-end program delivery by integrating roadmaps, dependencies, and resource plans across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other partner teams, ensuring milestones are met
Anticipate and resolve cross-team risks, constraints, and escalations using structured analysis and scenario planning to recommend path-forward options and maintain delivery predictability
Build and maintain transparent program communications including executive-ready updates, status reports, and visualizations that highlight progress, risks, and business impact for diverse audiences
Champion continuous improvement by standardizing program management practices, tools, and templates; coach other program and project managers in best practices to elevate execution quality across the organization
Use quantitative and qualitative insights to evaluate program outcomes against objectives, identify optimization opportunities, and inform future strategy, backlog, and investment decisions

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.

Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are
Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
10+ years of experience leading large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs in a technology, product, or operations environment, with increasing levels of scope, complexity, and autonomy — including the ability to define a path forward without waiting for structure to be provided
Demonstrated success owning end-to-end delivery for multi-stakeholder initiatives such as platform, data, or enterprise process transformations, including roadmap integration, dependency management, and benefits realization
Proven experience influencing and partnering with senior leaders and diverse functional teams to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
Experience implementing or improving program management practices such as governance models, portfolio reporting, or standardized tooling to increase efficiency, transparency, and scalability; comfortable pulling and interpreting data directly to pressure-test recommendations and drive decisions
